'''Gerald O. Barney''' (December 15, 1937 – September 9, 2020) was an American physicist, and expert in the field of [[sustainable development]], known as principal author of ''[[The Global 2000 Report to the President]].''<ref>[[Lester R. Brown]], ''Building a sustainable society.'' Worldwatch Institute. 1981. p. xii</ref><ref>[[Arne Næss|Næss, Arne]], and [[David Rothenberg]]. ''Ecology, community and lifestyle: outline of an ecosophy.'' Cambridge university press, 1990.</ref>

== Biography ==
Barney was born in 1937, and started his studies at the [[Goethe University Frankfurt]] in the year 1958–59. He then returned the States to [[Salem, Oregon]], where he obtained his BA at the [[Willamette University]] in 1961. Six years later he obtained his PhD in physics at the [[University of Wisconsin–Madison]], with a thesis on [[fusion energy]].<ref name="GB">[http://www.geraldbarney.com/aboutpage.html Gerald O. Barney] at ''geraldbarney.com.'' Revised 4 May 2006; Accessed 24-05-2017</ref>

After graduation Barney conducted postdoctoral research on the management of complex systems at MIT in 1970. he then joined the [[Rockefeller Brothers Fund]] as staff member in the field of environmental studies. in the late 1980s he management the research and of the production of ''[[The Global 2000 Report to the President]]'', issued by US President [[Jimmy Carter]].<ref name="GB"/>

In 1983 he founded the Millennium Institute to "promote long-term integrated global thinking in national governments, universities, foundations, and the faith traditions of the world,"<ref>Akira Onishi (2009), ''Integrated Global Models of Sustainable Development - Volume II:'' p. 29</ref><ref>Nick Hanna (1999), ''The Rough Guide to the Millennium,'' p. 296</ref> In 2013 he issued a follow-up of his famous 1980 report, entitled ''The Global 2000 Report to the President of the US: Entering the 21st Century: The Technical Report.''

Barney died on September 9, 2020, at the age of 81.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Gerald Orville Barney Obituary Sep 9, 2020 - Altogether |url=https://www.altogetherfuneral.com/obituaries/advent-funeral-cremation-services-falls-church/falls-church-virginia/gerald-barney/september-2020 |access-date=2026-08-31 |website=Advent Funeral & Cremation Services - Falls Church |language=en}}</ref>
